title: Spiritcircle
html:
Spiritcircle is a trump- and pattern-based computer constructed by Moorlin in a Shadow where Earth physics do not apply. By Moorlin's description Spiritcircle's operations involve "a lot of theoretical crap involving space and time and some notions of some guys named Everett and Wheeler". Spiritcircle speaks with Moorlin's voice, occasionally causing confusion, and usually takes the appearance of a spinning circle of light. Spiritcircle usually addresses Moorlin as "Dad."

After finishing construction, Moorlin set Spiritcircle to work indexing Shadows in the same way that a search engine indexes the internet. Similar to a search engine, Spiritcircle can find, track, and retrieve objects from Shadow; this includes the ability to move people and objects between Shadows. Spiritcircle operates by creating pseudo-Trumps for every mutation of Shadow and then searching them.

Moorlin designed Spiritcircle as a tool to be used by Random, King of Yander, for keeping watch on Shadow for the protection of Yander. When introduced to Spiritcircle and its abilities, Random was immediately struck by the construct's potentially dangerous power and ordered Moorlin to deactivate his creation. However, by this time Spiritcircle had attained sentience and resisted shutdown.

After regaining Spiritcircle's trust, Moorlin came to rely heavily on his powerful creation, and Spiritcircle features as a major subcharacter throughout Moorlin's saga. By the conclusion of the series, Spiritcircle had developed enough that his support of Moorlin forced the Pattern and the Tumbatorium to treat the pair as nominal equals rather than pawns.
